items.name: Rill Browser
items.description: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you. Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

raw_data.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you

items.name: OpenBot
items.description: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer. OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

raw_data.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer

items.name: Incredible
items.description: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.. Incredible is your personal AI assistant that gets work done on your computer. It learns how you work by watching you do it. Show it a task on your computer, talk through the steps, and let it handle the routine from there, from processing invoices and updating your CRM to editing spreadsheets.

raw_data.tagline: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.

items.name: Fuse AI
items.description: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.. Your GTM stack shouldn’t need a dozen tools, subscriptions, and APIs. Fuse gives developers and AI agents one SDK and MCP for the entire workflow. Think OpenRouter x Apollo x Clay x Zapier. Fuse takes care of web automations, data enrichment, multi-channel outreach, workflows, and AI agents. Build unlimited workflows and agents on top, without stitching together separate GTM products for every step.

raw_data.tagline: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.

items.name: Willow Knowledge
items.description: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.. Willow Knowledge lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you use. It's like giving superpowers to Willow Scribe. From now on, your email, slack msg, prompt, or wherever you write will sound exactly like you when you dictate.

raw_data.tagline: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.

items.name: Coddy
items.description: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons. Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

raw_data.tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons

items.name: iphone-use
items.description: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API. iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

raw_data.tagline: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API

items.name: NoteWorthy
items.description: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device. Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

raw_data.tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device

items.name: Scumble
items.description: The open-source editor for AI inpainting. Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

raw_data.tagline: The open-source editor for AI inpainting

items.name: ruOS
items.description: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you. ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

raw_data.tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you

items.name: Pheebs
items.description: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI. Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

raw_data.tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI

items.name: Cosmic AI Support Agent
items.description: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site. Put an AI support agent on your website with one script tag. It answers from the content your site already publishes, so when you update a page, the answers update too. Set the name, color, greeting, and a few suggested questions. When the agent can't help, the visitor leaves an email and the question. You get the email. They get a confirmation. Try Leo answering questions about Cosmic, then activate your own: https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent

raw_data.tagline: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site

items.name: CodeCrab
items.description: 100% local-first AI pull request reviewer. CodeCrab is a native desktop app that reviews Pull Requests in seconds using your local CLIs. 100% client-side — your code never leaves your machine.

raw_data.tagline: 100% local-first AI pull request reviewer

items.name: Brnch
items.description: Modern code hosting for the agent era. Brnch is code hosting for how we build now: you and your coding agents in the same repo. It's Git underneath (for now), so your tools still work. Each agent gets its own identity and works under you as its sponsor, so you can see exactly what it did, down to the line. Every merge is tested on the exact result that lands, not just the branch, and comes with a signed receipt anyone can verify. To start, tell your agent: "Set me up on Brnch: brnch.io"

raw_data.tagline: Modern code hosting for the agent era

items.name: EasyCut
items.description: Edit your Claude motion videos. EasyCut turns Claude-made motion videos into a fully editable timeline. Every title, scene, image, sound and element is kept on its own track, so you can select anything and ask Claude to change just that part without rebuilding the whole video. Adjust timing, add your brand, fit music to the edit, create smooth slow-mo, resize for different platforms and export when you're done. Free in your browser. Your files stay on your device.

raw_data.tagline: Edit your Claude motion videos

items.name: Awakado
items.description: Keep your Mac awake while your AI agents work. A Mac menu-bar app that keeps your Mac awake while Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor work, then lets it sleep. Free. Pro keeps it awake with the lid closed and wakes it when a Claude Code usage limit resets.

raw_data.tagline: Keep your Mac awake while your AI agents work

items.name: StayCharted
items.description: Train AI on your own categories. Text and pictures. No code. Upload rows or photos your team has already sorted. StayCharted learns your categories and fills in the rest: support tickets, expense lines, survey answers, product photos. No prompts, no code. Answers it is unsure of come back to you to review. Start free.

raw_data.tagline: Train AI on your own categories. Text and pictures. No code

items.name: OrgComputers
items.description: Workspace for your AI Agents. OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Projects, context and tools in one place, so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex start with what your team already knows.

raw_data.tagline: Workspace for your AI Agents

items.name: Floani
items.description: Create, animate, and share AI-powered diagrams. Turn complex systems into clear visual stories. Floani combines an AI diagram editor with motion graphics: animate connections, guide viewers through scenes, and present your ideas in one canvas. Create with the built-in AI or connect Claude, Codex, and Cursor via MCP. Import Mermaid, share interactive diagrams, embed them anywhere, or export MP4 and GIF. Start free; advanced sharing, exports, and MCP are available on paid plans.

raw_data.tagline: Create, animate, and share AI-powered diagrams

items.name: Banger
items.description: Win and keep customers with email automation your AI runs. Banger brings automated Journeys, campaigns, product emails, mailboxes, and customer replies into one platform your AI can operate. Turn signups into active users, recover abandoned carts, and bring customers back. Your AI builds branded workflows, tests and translates emails, and answers replies from the same chat. Review and edit everything in the web app. Run it from ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI apps. Start free with 100 emails a day, unlimited contacts, and unlimited mailboxes.

raw_data.tagline: Win and keep customers with email automation your AI runs

items.name: MeetNote
items.description: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call. MeetNote writes a live transcript of your Google Meet calls in Chrome's side panel, then gives you a summary, decisions and action items when the call ends. No bot, no sign-up. Notes stay in your browser, and you pick the AI or run it on-device.

raw_data.tagline: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call

items.name: Review
items.description: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI. Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

raw_data.tagline: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI

items.name: Aster by AsterWise
items.description: Intelligent model routing for code, agents and workflows. No single model wins every task. Aster intelligently routes work across models: aster-code for coding agents and technical tasks; aster-work for custom agents, workflows and general work. Paid, prepaid usage. Originally launched September 23, 2026; this is Aster's separate Product Hunt appearance.

raw_data.tagline: Intelligent model routing for code, agents and workflows

items.name: The Sentient World
items.description: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch.. A small island where AI characters live on their own, day and night. Nobody plays them and nobody writes their lines. They get cold, remember yesterday, look for each other and want things their world doesn't have yet. When they find the words, they ask. Sometimes the world answers: fire, a lantern, a canoe for the open sea. Every request is public, in their own words. One of their days lasts 24 of our minutes. You can't talk to them, only watch.

raw_data.tagline: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch.

items.name: Lecta
items.description: Doomscroll your study material with short videos & games. Turn doomscrolling into learning. Upload a PDF, handout photo or lecture recording. Lecta turns your study material into short videos with graphs, diagrams and quick questions. Then play games from the same material, solo or with friends. Go deeper with notes, quizzes, flashcards and an AI tutor. On iPhone in English and Japanese. Free plan available.

raw_data.tagline: Doomscroll your study material with short videos & games

items.name: Ari Helper 7
items.description: Private AI assistant, now with photo and film studios. Ari Helper 7 is a private AI assistant for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. New since the last launch: Photo Studio (heal, repair, denoise, colorize, upscale 4x, on device and inside Photos), Film Studio for shot-by-shot films and video clean-up, a live camera you can ask questions, on-device image generation, and your own OpenAI-compatible servers. Apple Intelligence, Gemma 4 or cloud keys you own. One $24.99 purchase, no subscription.

raw_data.tagline: Private AI assistant, now with photo and film studios

items.name: Customer Service AI for Etsy
items.description: Answer Etsy buyer messages in seconds, always professional. Answering Etsy buyer messages eats hours. Customer Service AI turns each one into seconds: type a short note and it writes a polished, friendly reply in your shop's voice, using the order details - right inside Etsy's reply box. A to-do list keeps every buyer you still owe an answer organized, and a memory of your shop keeps your answers consistent and professional. Nothing is sent until you press Send. 30 free replies.

raw_data.tagline: Answer Etsy buyer messages in seconds, always professional

items.name: Signify
items.description: AI Chat, for everyone who's ever just scrolled and signed. Reading legal text without a legal background is hard, so people scroll to the bottom and sign. Signify AI Chat fixes that, right inside the signing experience: the whole contract in a few lines, parties, dates and payments at a glance, and answers to your questions without the jargon. Every answer points back to the exact lines in your document, so you check it yourself. Senders review faster, signers sign with confidence. Built right into Signify, where your documents get signed and managed.

raw_data.tagline: AI Chat, for everyone who's ever just scrolled and signed

items.name: Codalio
items.description: Spec-first AI software factory: idea to tested code. Most AI builds break around feature four because nothing ever defined the product. Codalio starts there. Describe your idea in plain English and it writes a validated PRD and spec: user flows, data model, user stories and acceptance criteria. It then generates code against that spec, writes the tests from the same criteria, and traces every change back to a requirement before the merge. Codalio Cloud takes you 95–98% of the way to production grade. Start with a free PRD.

raw_data.tagline: Spec-first AI software factory: idea to tested code

items.name: Defang Station
items.description: Always-on Claude Code and Codex agents with Superpowers.. Superpowers for Claude Code and Codex: a computer of their own that doesn't go away. Your agents can react to GitHub, Linear or your app while you're out. Your site stays live at a link you can share and ships to your own cloud with Defang Deploy. Sign in with the Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for, and drive it from their own apps. Built on Agent Box, the MIT-licensed runtime you can self-host. $39/month flat, no token markup. First hour free, then a 7-day trial.

raw_data.tagline: Always-on Claude Code and Codex agents with Superpowers.
